sectionDescription: Controls when the "On this page" table of contents is shown while viewing a page.
checkboxLabel: Always show the table of contents
checkboxDescription: By default the table of contents only appears once a page has more than 3 headings. Turn this on to always show it, even on pages with just one or two headings.
updateError: Could not update the table of contents setting

modeDescriptions.auto: Show the table of contents when a page has more than three headings. Hide it on shorter pages.
modeDescriptions.always: Show the table of contents on every page, regardless of its heading count.
modeDescriptions.never: Keep the table of contents hidden while leaving page content unchanged.
